raw_text: Thread: AIIMS Delhi patient data spotted on darknet marketplace. Listing claims to have 30-40 million records including Aadhaar numbers, diagnoses, and treatment histories. Seller asking 200 BTC. Sample data looks authentic — includes OPD registration numbers matching AIIMS format. Listing appeared approximately 6 hours ago. If genuine, this is one of the largest healthcare data breaches in Indian history. No official confirmation from AIIMS administration yet.
